It’s such a wonderful feature for a home studio. Im trying to figure out how to get those little dents out if support or anyone has any suggestions. This is nice sounding beginners cajon. It looks very nice, the included strap is fine. The build quality is very good for the price, sound quality compares well to other entry-level cajons I have, but of course if you're a pro, you're probably going to want to spend more for something nicer. I do appreciate being able to adjust the strings, which I can't do on some of my others. For my occasional use, just jamming for fun, or using it for the occasional sound effect in the studio, this is a great addition to my collection.

Just pulled them out of the box. The 20-inch ride sounds surprisingly good. I was afraid it would be harsh, but it's not. The 18 & 16 inch crash are also pretty good, tho, if you're looking for a splashy crash you might be disappointed. They boarder on "tinny". I haven't set up the hihat yet, but I think they'll do just fine. And they do a pretty good job of not being loud.
